description: National estimated lamb carcass cutout value (LM_XL502). Returns gross carcass value, foresaddle value (rib, shoulder, breast/neck), hindsaddle value (leg, loin), net carcass value, and other byproduct values (pelt, offal). Published daily on USDA business days. Source: USDA LMPR Datamart, US Government public domain.
